work.title: Big Boy 2
work.description: Outline of a standing figure with arms extended occupies the full vertical format, with three compact discs suspended at each hand and chest. Text reading 'BIG BOY' appears at top; a side-view warplane silhouette is positioned at the figure's feet.
work.composition: Full-figure outline with suspended disc elements
work.dimensions_source: cd-reference: 3 CDs measured (2.9% spread), mean 197.8px dia = 41.91px/in, applied to 1630x2800 native. Circle fit confirmed against disc edge at high zoom. Verified 2026-08-04.
